comparison.objective: Secure an upright gas cylinder to a wall bracket using its chain.
comparison.physical_skill: Route and tension an articulated chain around a large load, seat a link in a hook, and avoid the valve.
comparison.success_condition: Chain snug and hooked at the specified height; cylinder upright and retained under a 10 N pull after release.
comparison.reason: Chain routing and load restraint do not exercise orientation-sensitive screening, selective passage, or loose-media recovery.
